newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books halts acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books halts acquisition talks.

text.p: Children's book publisher Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc. said Monday it withdrew a proposal to buy Nelvana Ltd., but remains interested in venturing into the children's television programming area.

Previously, the company proposed acquiring the Canadian producer of children's and family television programming for $102 million in cash and stock. Golden Books did not explain why it withdrew the offer.
Golden Books publishes children's books in North America, and owns a library of family entertainment copyrights.
Golden Books stock was down 12.5 cents at $10.875 in early trading on Nasdaq. Nelvana was unchanged at C$27 in early trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
